explication: Pumpkin is a Rust Minecraft server. A player connects through the Java or Bedrock protocol, interacts with server-managed player, command, inventory, and world systems, and receives game-state updates. The server also loads configuration and plugins; world processing includes chunk lifecycle and lighting. The graph reflects documented capabilities and indexed source references; several major subsystems are represented at directory level because their implementation was not sampled.
